name: cowxlabs-site
description: Cowx Labs company site: marketing pages, admin panel, and employee/client portals.

scripts.install:all: cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,ui -c yellow,cyan "cd backend && npm run dev" "cd frontend && npm run dev"
scripts.build: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.start: npm install --prefix backend && npm run serve --prefix backend
